units: nonzero source-service edge observations across polls/window
window_scope: completed OpenFlow switch-destination window from counter deltas

feature_semantics.pkt_rate: sum of positive tracking-rule packet deltas divided by window duration
feature_semantics.byte_rate: sum of positive tracking-rule byte deltas divided by window duration
feature_semantics.pkt_sum: sum of positive tracking-rule packet deltas
feature_semantics.events: number of polling intervals containing any positive packet or byte delta
feature_semantics.unique_src: number of distinct source addresses with a positive delta
feature_semantics.src_ip_entropy: Shannon entropy of source identities across nonzero source-edge observations
feature_semantics.flow_count: count of nonzero source-service tracking-edge observations across all polls

missing_values: reject missing columns; reject nonnumeric, NaN and infinite values
calibration: none; forest vote probabilities are not claimed calibrated
split_procedure: actual OVS whole-run training followed by disjoint later whole-run validation; untouched confirmatory seeds excluded
